Class GoogleSearchResult

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.googler.engine.internal.GoogleSearchResult
All Implemented Interfaces:

public class GoogleSearchResult extends Object implements Serializable
Encapsulates all the results returned from Google in one search

  • Constructor Details

    • GoogleSearchResult

      public GoogleSearchResult()
      Empty Constructor

    • GoogleSearchResult

      public GoogleSearchResult(boolean documentFiltering, String searchComments, int estimatedTotalResultsCount, boolean estimateIsExact, ResultElement[] resultElements, String searchQuery, int startIndex, int endIndex, String searchTips, DirectoryCategory[] directoryCategories, double searchTime)
      Creates a new GoogleSearchResult with all it's atributes initiated
      Parameters:
      documentFiltering - Indicates if there was some filtering in the results
      searchComments - Indicates if there was some filtering in the results
      estimatedTotalResultsCount - Number of results that Google expects for the associated query
      estimateIsExact - If true, the total results estimation is exact
      resultElements - The individual results for the search
      searchQuery - The string that was sent to Google for the query
      startIndex - Zero-based index of the first result in this object
      endIndex - Zero-based index of the last result in this object
      searchTips - Recomendation from Google to the user regarding the search
      directoryCategories - Categories that seems to be related to this search
      searchTime - Time needed by Google to process this request
